name: daydock
description: A calm, local-first workday command center built with modern React and the web platform.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/finalize-service-worker.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode pages && node scripts/finalize-service-worker.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.check: npm run verify && npm run build
